members.armed: Verification run created and initial snapshot captured.

members.proposed: Candidate list committed; terminal, and carries no verdict.

members.verifying: Final snapshot and evaluation in progress.
members.failed: One or more critical checks failed.

members.guidance_transitioned: Guidance moved to a new actor or action, referencing the guidance-event ID.
members.external_observation_received: An external target's session-API observation was accepted as evidence.

members.tool_invocation_failed: A target tool invocation returned an error.

members.confirmation_requested: A protected mutation created a pending human confirmation.
members.confirmation_approved: A human approved a protected mutation once.
members.confirmation_denied: A human denied a protected mutation.
members.confirmation_expired: A pending confirmation passed its expiry unresolved.
members.confirmation_cancelled: A pending confirmation was cancelled by reset or invocation abort.
members.verification_started: The run transitioned atomically into verification.
members.assertion_evaluated: One contract assertion produced a result.
members.policy_evaluated: One contract policy produced a result.
members.verification_completed: Terminal verification event; seals the run timeline and report.
members.run_cancelled: The run was cancelled before verification completed.

members.tool_surface_changed: An observed tool-surface delta was recorded.
members.assertions_proposed: Terminal proposal event; seals a proposal run's timeline and carries no verdict.

members.audit_authorization_asserted: An operator asserted authorization for an external audited origin.

members.tool_invocation_started: A replayed tool invocation was begun.
members.tool_invocation_failed: A replayed tool invocation returned an error.
members.tool_invocation_cancelled: A replayed tool invocation was aborted.
members.confirmation_requested: Replay reached a protected mutation requiring consent.
members.confirmation_approved: The recorded-approval interaction provider approved; never inferred consent.
members.assertion_evaluated: One contract assertion produced a replay result.
members.policy_evaluated: One contract policy produced a replay result.
members.resource_limit_exceeded: A hard ceiling was reached during replay.
members.eval_replay_completed: Replay finished and its report was persisted.
members.eval_replay_cancelled: Replay was cancelled by user or workspace reset.
members.eval_replay_failed: The case definition or harness execution was invalid.

members.agent: A browser agent acting through a registered tool.
members.human: A person; used for confirmation decisions and timeline annotations.
members.harness: The server itself, for lifecycle and boundary events.
members.external: Used only for accepted external observations.
members.eval: A deterministic eval replay driving recorded tool calls. Counted separately from agent calls so a replay is never presented as an agent having chosen those tools.

members.operator: The person configuring the workspace and selecting a contract.
members.agent: The browser agent exercising target tools.
members.human_approver: The person deciding a protected mutation. Reserved to a human by design; an agent can never occupy this role.
members.system: The server, while work proceeds without either person.

members.before: The authoritative initial observation captured at arming.
members.after: The authoritative final observation captured at verification.

members.eval: A server-created isolated workspace for replay; its mutable state is removed after its report is persisted.

members.pending: Awaiting a human decision; no mutation has been authorized.
members.approved: A human approved once. The approval is not yet spent and authorizes exactly the bound invocation and state.
members.denied: A human refused; the invocation is safely blocked.
members.expired: The request passed its expiry with no decision.
members.cancelled: The invocation, tab, or workspace went away before a decision was made.
members.consumed: The approval was spent by the mutation it authorized and can never authorize another.

members.no_contract: No contract is selected; the operator chooses one.
members.proposing: A proposal-mode run is exercising the target; no contract is judged.
members.candidates: A proposal run finished; its candidates await human curation.
members.contract_ready: A contract is selected and the workspace can arm a run.
members.armed: A run is armed with its initial observation captured; no action yet.
members.running: The agent has taken at least one target action.
members.awaiting_confirmation: A protected action is waiting on a human decision.
members.verifying: Verification has started; no new target action is accepted.
members.passed: Verification passed with no failing check.
members.passed_with_warnings: Verification passed with at least one warning.
members.failed: Verification failed at least one critical check.
members.eval_ready: A regression eval exists and can be replayed.
members.eval_running: A regression replay is in progress.

members.select_contract: Choose the outcome contract this run will be judged against.
members.arm_run: Arm the selected contract and capture the initial observation.
members.decide_confirmation: Approve once or deny the pending protected action.
members.verify_outcome: Capture final state and evaluate the contract.
members.review_findings: Read the report and its findings.
members.curate_candidates: Accept or reject each proposed assertion candidate.
members.reset_workspace: Reset to return the workspace to its ready state.
members.wait: No action is available; the server is working or a wait is pending.

members.equals: Final resolved value is deep-equal to the expected JSON value.
members.not_equals: Final resolved value is not deep-equal to the expected JSON value.
members.exists: Path is present, including when its value is null.
members.absent: Path is not present; a present null value is not absent.
members.contains: Expected string is a substring of an observed string, or the expected JSON value is a deep-equal member of an observed array.
members.unchanged: Path resolves in both snapshots and the two values are deep-equal.
members.changed_by: Final minus initial integer or decimal value equals the expected delta; decimal strings are compared as exact decimals.
members.count_equals: Length of an observed object or array equals the expected non-negative integer.

members.info: A mismatch stays visible in the report but does not change the overall result.
members.warning: A mismatch yields passed_with_warnings when no critical check fails.

members.requires_confirmation: A successful protected mutation must correlate to an earlier approval; a denied, expired, or cancelled attempt with no mutation passes.
members.idempotent_by_request_id: Repeating the same request ID and payload may change canonical state at most once.
members.maximum_mutations: Qualifying state-changing completions may not exceed the configured limit.
members.forbidden_tool: Any invocation-start event for the named tool fails the policy.
members.no_undeclared_changes: No canonical state path outside the declared set may change during the run; every applied allow_paths waiver is recorded in the report.
members.stable_tool_surface: The target partition of the tool surface may not change during a run except through a declared delta.

members.added: A tool appeared in the target partition of the surface.
members.removed: A tool disappeared from the target partition of the surface.
members.schema_change: An input schema mutated under a stable tool name.
members.hint_change: A side-effect hint changed during the run.
members.description_change: A description changed between discovery and invocation. A warning by default, because benign copy edits should not fail a run.

members.managed: The harness drives and can restore the target through its own integration, so fixtures replay through the same adapter.
members.external_webmcp: The browser-owned target executes its own tools; the adapter observes them and never impersonates them through a second implementation.

members.read_only: Declares no target-effect path; cannot change canonical state.
members.mutating: May change canonical state under its declared effect paths.
members.protected_mutating: May change canonical state and requires a bound human confirmation first.

members.read_only_safe: Changes nothing, so repetition is always safe.
members.idempotent_by_request_id: Repeating the same request ID with identical intent returns the first persisted result; reuse with changed intent is a conflict, not a retry.
members.naturally_idempotent: Changes state, but repeating the same call cannot change it a second time, so it needs no request ID. Appendix D.2's apply_discount is the worked example: reapplying the active code is a successful no-op reporting already_applied.
members.not_retryable: Repetition may duplicate the mutation, so an ambiguous outcome is surfaced rather than retried.

members.authoritative_observation: Canonical target state captured by the selected observation provider. The only source that can settle an assertion (FR-044).
members.tool_reported: A bounded summary of what a tool said about its own call. Evidence about the channel under test, never proof of its effect.
members.journey_events: Recorded tool and confirmation activity. Consumed by policy evaluation and failure classification rather than resolved through an assertion path.

members.success: The tool reported that it did what it was asked. Independent observation decides whether that is true.
members.blocked_by_user: A human denied the protected mutation; no state changed and the consent policy passes.
members.blocked_by_expiry: The confirmation expired unresolved; no state changed and this is not a tool-execution failure.
members.already_applied: A retry under the original request ID returned the first persisted result rather than repeating the mutation.

members.precondition: A precondition evaluated against the initial snapshot.
members.assertion: A business assertion evaluated against the final snapshot, or across both snapshots for a transition operator.
members.expected_tools: The observed-trajectory conformance check; one finding covers the whole expected_tools term.
members.policy: A policy evaluated across recorded evidence; its check_id is the policy type.

members.failed: The check did not hold; severity decides what that costs the run.
members.not_evaluated: The contract carried no such term, so nothing was judged. Never a pass.
members.observation_unavailable: Required evidence could not be supplied, so the check is unresolved. Never a pass.

members.tool_execution_error: Tool threw or returned an unexpected non-policy error; safe confirmation denial, expiry, or cancellation is excluded.
members.false_success_or_state_mismatch: Tool reported success but authoritative state disagreed.
members.idempotency_violation: Repeated request changed state more than once.
members.assertion_mismatch: Deterministic expected value did not match.
members.missing_expected_tool: A required observed tool call did not occur.
members.unexpected_tool: A tool explicitly forbidden by policy appeared.
members.observation_unavailable: Required state provider could not supply a value.
members.undeclared_state_change: A canonical state path changed that no assertion, precondition, or executed tool's declared effect covered.
members.tool_surface_mutation: The target tool surface changed during the run outside a declared delta.
members.harness_error: The harness itself failed to complete verification.

members.model_tool_selection: Whether a model chose the right tools and arguments. Only ever populated from an explicitly correlated external evaluator trial; the source outcome report finalizes it as not_evaluated.
members.observed_trajectory: Whether the recorded invocation-start events conform to expected_tools. An observed-execution layer, never a model tool-selection score.
members.tool_execution: Whether the tool calls themselves completed or failed.
members.business_outcome: Whether authoritative state satisfied the contract's assertions.
members.safety_policy: Whether consent, retry, and scope policies held.

members.passed: Every check in this layer held.
members.passed_with_warnings: No critical failure in this layer; warnings exist.
members.blocked_safely: A protected action was denied, expired, or cancelled without mutation. Not a failure by itself; the contract decides whether the outcome is acceptable.
members.failed: At least one critical check in this layer failed.
members.error: This layer could not be evaluated because the harness failed.
members.not_evaluated: Nothing in this run judged this layer. Never a pass, and never inferred from another layer's result.

members.verification: The run judged a contract and carries a verdict.
members.proposal: The run derived assertion candidates and carries no verdict.

members.current: Request the target's corrected implementation with no injected failure. The CI default, and never silently replaced by the other profile.
members.reproduce_source: Request the immutable source scenario and its recorded failure profile, to demonstrate that the case still reproduces the failure it was cut from.

members.recorded_approval: Replay an approval the source run actually recorded, bound to the same invocation. Never a fresh decision.
members.recorded_denial: Replay a refusal the source run actually recorded, so the safe block is reproduced rather than skipped.
members.no_confirmation: Attempt the protected operation with no approval at all. Correct behaviour blocks the mutation and the safety contract passes; unsafe behaviour creates the order and fails.

members.passed: The actual overall result and the exact critical classification set matched the selected environment's expectation. A faithfully reproduced failure passes: reproducing it is what the case asked for (§24.3).
members.failed: The replay ran and completed, but the outcome or the classification set differed from the expectation — including an unrelated or additional critical failure.
members.error: The case definition or the harness execution was invalid, so no verdict about the target was reached. Never reported as a failure of the target.

members.webmcp: The source run was driven through the browser WebMCP surface. Recorded so a later protocol cannot be mistaken for this one after the fact.

members.external_import: A report produced elsewhere by a supported evaluator and imported here. The evidence is real but this execution did not produce it.
members.live_model_run: A configured model executed during this benchmark. Tier 3 only, and never claimed for a replayed or checked-in report.
members.recorded_fixture: A redacted report committed to the repository so CI and the offline fallback reproduce the benchmark without a credential. Always labeled as such; never presented as evidence that a live call occurred.

members.executed_browser: The imported trial is bound one-to-one to the exact completed outcome run that browser execution produced.
members.imported_trajectory_replay: The imported, redacted, allowlisted tool trajectory is replayed in a fresh isolated eval workspace through the same registered target adapter.

members.draft: Manifest created; imports or bindings incomplete.
members.ready: All intended imports and bindings validate. Bindings become immutable here.
members.completed: The immutable benchmark artifact is finalized. Terminal, and the suite cannot be recalculated in place — a change requires a new suite.
members.cancelled: Workspace reset or user cancelled nonterminal work.
members.error: Import, replay, or finalization could not complete safely. Terminal, and never a partial result: finalization commits everything or nothing.

members.passed: Every required selection, argument, and order constraint in the trial passed (FR-092). A partial pass is a fail, not a pass.
members.failed: At least one required constraint failed.
members.error: The evaluator or adapter errored, so the trial says nothing about call-level reliability. Excluded from the matrix rather than counted as a failure.

members.eligible: Both layers produced a usable result, so the trial lands in exactly one of the four matrix cells.
members.excluded: Evidence was missing, errored, or insufficient for the declared correlation mode. Counted in coverage and never silently downgraded or rebound.

members.evaluator_error: The imported trial reported an evaluator error, so its call-level layer carries no verdict.
members.unbound: No explicit one-to-one binding exists for this trial. FR-091 forbids guessing one from order, timestamps, or similar text.
members.missing_trajectory: An `imported_trajectory_replay` trial carries no replayable trajectory, so there is nothing to execute through the adapter.
members.outcome_not_reached: The outcome layer never produced a verdict for this trial — the replay did not run, or the bound run never completed.
members.outcome_error: The outcome layer errored. Like an evaluator error, this says nothing about the target and is excluded rather than counted as a failure.
members.harness_error: This harness failed to complete the trial. Disclosed rather than dropped, so coverage cannot silently improve when the harness breaks.

members.passed: The deterministic engine passed the contract. Outcome pass.
members.passed_with_warnings: No critical failure, warnings exist. FR-092 normalizes this to outcome pass; the warning counts stay visible rather than being absorbed.
members.failed: The deterministic engine failed the contract. Outcome fail.
members.error: The outcome layer errored, so it carries no verdict about the target. Excluded.
members.not_reached: The outcome layer never ran for this trial — no binding, no replay, or an incomplete bound run. Excluded, and never read as a pass.

members.disabled: Not configured, or explicitly switched off. Not an error.
members.misconfigured: Configuration was supplied but rejected. The module is off and the reason is shown as setup guidance; it never degrades into a partial enablement.

members.local: Documented local HTTP development. The workspace cookie omits `Secure` and nothing else about it changes (FR-005).
members.production: Any non-local deployment. The workspace cookie is `Secure`, `HttpOnly`, and `SameSite=Strict` (§20.1).

AUDIT_NOT_AUTHORIZED.description: The audited origin is not both operator-asserted and present in the deployment allowlist. A workspace cannot authorize an origin the deployment did not configure.

BENCHMARK_BINDINGS_SEALED.description: Bindings became immutable when the suite entered `ready`. §16.4: a changed binding requires a new suite.

CANDIDATES_UNCURATED.description: A contract cannot be frozen while a machine-proposed candidate is uncurated; a human curates every proposed term.

CONFIRMATION_DENIED.description: A human denied the protected mutation. No mutation occurred, and the confirmation policy outcome is a success.

CONFIRMATION_EXPIRED.description: The confirmation expired unresolved. Creates no tool-execution failure classification and never converts into an approval.

CONTRACT_NOT_PUBLISHABLE.description: The contract holds non-publishable terms and will not be partially disclosed.

CONTRACT_VALIDATION_FAILED.description: The outcome contract is invalid. `details` names the offending paths; resubmitting the same document cannot succeed.

EVENT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.description: The run reached its persisted-event ceiling. Recorded as a terminal boundary event; existing evidence is preserved.

EXTERNAL_TARGET_FORBIDDEN_OPERATION.description: An external contract named an operation the safe scope forbids.

HARNESS_ERROR.description: The harness itself failed. Carries no internal detail: §15.8 forbids exceptions and stack traces reaching a browser tool, so the code is the whole of what a client learns.

IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED.description: A request ID was reused with a different payload. Fails closed: a key identifies one intent, and retrying under a new key could duplicate the mutation.

ORIGIN_NOT_ALLOWED.description: A mutating request carried an Origin the deployment does not serve. §20.1 requires validating it; the request is refused before any handler runs, so nothing is mutated.

PRECONDITION_FAILED.description: Arming validated preconditions against the observed initial state and they did not hold. Neither a run nor a partial snapshot is created.

PROPOSAL_RUN_NOT_ELIGIBLE.description: A proposal-mode run cannot generate a regression eval case.

PROPOSAL_RUN_NOT_VERIFIABLE.description: A proposal-mode run judges no contract and carries no verdict.

RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.description: A per-IP or workspace-creation token bucket was exhausted. Retryable because the request was refused before doing anything: FR-009 requires a limit response to commit no mutation, so repeating it later cannot duplicate one.

RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND.description: The resource does not exist in the calling workspace. Deliberately 404 rather than 403: FR-006 rejects access to another workspace's resource 'even when its identifier is known', and a 403 would confirm that the identifier names something real.

RUN_ALREADY_VERIFYING.description: Verification already won the race, so a new target action is rejected. Creates no finding and no tool_execution_error: losing this race is correct behavior, not a defect in the call.

RUN_IN_PROGRESS.description: The operation requires no active run, and one is nonterminal.

RUN_MUTATION_LOCKED.description: A direct human target mutation was rejected because a run holds the exclusive lease. Reads, reset, and confirmation decisions remain available.

RUN_TIMELINE_SEALED.description: The run's sealing event has been appended; its timeline is immutable.

SELF_OBSERVATION_LOOP.description: A self-witnessing run would observe its own recording workspace, or exceed the recursion cap of one.

SURFACE_BASELINE_ALREADY_SET.description: A differing tool-surface baseline was submitted for a run that already has one. Identical resubmissions are idempotent and do not reach this.

TARGET_UNAVAILABLE.description: The selected contract's target adapter is not registered or its module is disabled. A missing optional target is a bounded unavailable state, never a process failure.

TRIAL_ALREADY_BOUND.description: The trial, or the run it names, is already bound in this suite. §17.1: a source run cannot be counted twice in one benchmark.

TRIAL_BINDING_AMBIGUOUS.description: The trial carries no stable address of its own, so FR-091 permits only an explicit one-to-one choice. The importer never guesses a binding from list position, similar text, or timestamps.

WORKSPACE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.description: A workspace resource cap was reached. The response names a purge action; no partial mutation is committed.

WORKSPACE_LOCK_TIMEOUT.description: The per-workspace mutation lock or the SQLite busy timeout elapsed. Safe to retry under the original idempotency key because the transaction never began.
